question: What is TNRM and why doesn't Hope For Strays UM just relocate or remove strays from campus?
questionMs: Apakah itu TNRM dan mengapa Hope For Strays UM tidak memindahkan sahaja haiwan terbiar keluar dari kampus?
answer: TNRM stands for Trap-Neuter-Return-Manage. Scientific evidence worldwide shows that simply catching and relocating strays creates a 'Vacuum Effect' — when animals are removed from an area with food and shelter, unsterilized strays from surrounding neighborhoods quickly migrate in and breed at higher rates. Through TNRM, we sterilize and vaccinate the resident population, notch their ears for identification, and manage their feeding stations. Over time, the population naturally stabilizes and declines without aggression or continuous influx.
answerMs: TNRM bermaksud Tangkap-Mandul-Lepas-Urus (Trap-Neuter-Return-Manage). Kajian global membuktikan bahawa menangkap dan memindahkan haiwan jalanan hanya mencetuskan 'Kesan Vakum' (Vacuum Effect) — apabila haiwan dipindahkan, haiwan terbiar lain yang belum dimandulkan akan masuk dan membiak lebih pantas. Melalui TNRM, haiwan dimandulkan, divaksin, ditanda telinga dan diuruskan jadual makanannya supaya populasi stabil dan berkurangan secara semula jadi.

question: Why is an animal's left ear notched or tipped? Is it painful?
questionMs: Mengapakah telinga kiri haiwan jalanan ditakuk/dipotong sedikit? Adakah ia menyakitkan?
answer: Ear-notching (a clean 0.5cm straight clip on the left ear tip) is the universal, internationally recognized mark of a neutered community animal. It is performed by a licensed veterinary surgeon while the animal is under deep general anesthesia during spay/neuter surgery, so the animal feels no pain. It heals quickly and allows rescue teams, campus security, and council officers to identify sterile animals from a safe distance, preventing traumatic re-trapping or redundant surgery.
answerMs: Takukan telinga (potongan bersih 0.5cm pada hujung telinga kiri) adalah simbol pengenalan antarabangsa bagi haiwan komuniti yang telah dimandulkan. Prosedur ini dilakukan oleh doktor veterinar bertauliah semasa haiwan berada di bawah bius umum penuh semasa pembedahan mandul, maka haiwan tidak berasa sakit. Ini mengelakkan haiwan daripada ditangkap atau dibedah semula.

question: How do I report an injured, sick, or unneutered stray animal on UM campus or nearby in Selangor?
questionMs: Bagaimanakah cara melaporkan haiwan jalanan yang cedera, sakit, atau belum dimandulkan di kampus UM atau Selangor?
answer: If you spot a stray in urgent distress on Universiti Malaya campus or Petaling Jaya: (1) Take a clear photo or video showing the animal and its exact surroundings/landmark, (2) Note whether the left ear has a notch, (3) Do not chase or corner the animal, and (4) Send the photo, exact Google Maps live location, and a brief description to our Volunteer TNRM Hotline via WhatsApp (+60 10-550 3056). Our field rescue volunteers prioritize emergencies based on medical urgency.
answerMs: Jika anda menemui haiwan jalanan yang memerlukan bantuan di kampus UM atau Petaling Jaya: (1) Ambil gambar/video jelas bersama mercu tanda lokasi, (2) Periksa jika telinga kirinya bertakuk, (3) Jangan kejar haiwan tersebut, dan (4) Hantar lokasi langsung Google Maps serta butiran ke WhatsApp Talian Hotline TNRM kami (+60 10-550 3056).

question: How does personal animal sponsorship work (e.g. RM30/month), and what perks do I receive?
questionMs: Bagaimanakah sistem penajaan haiwan secara peribadi (cth. RM30/bulan) berfungsi, dan apakah faedah yang saya terima?
answer: Under our personalized sponsorship program (inspired by international wildlife adoptee models), you can choose a specific rescue dog or cat (e.g. Kopi, Milo, Bella) to support. Under the RM30/month 'Rescue Companion' tier, your donation directly funds their daily nutrition, clinical wound dressing, and shelter boarding. In return, you receive: (1) A personalized digital Certificate of Sponsorship, (2) Monthly photo and video progress updates dispatched via WhatsApp or Email, and (3) An invitation to schedule occasional supervised visits to spend time with your sponsored animal at our Petaling Jaya sanctuary, subject to availability and shelter safety guidelines.
answerMs: Melalui program penajaan peribadi kami, anda boleh memilih haiwan reskue khusus untuk ditaja (cth. Kopi, Milo, Bella). Di bawah kategori RM30/bulan 'Sahabat Reskue', sumbangan anda membiayai makanan harian dan rawatan klinikal haiwan tersebut. Anda akan menerima: (1) Sijil Digital Penajaan Peribadi, (2) Laporan bulanan bergambar & video melalui WhatsApp/Emel, dan (3) Peluang menjadualkan sesi lawatan mesra bersama haiwan tataan anda di santuari kami.

question: Is my donation tax-deductible in Malaysia, and how do I receive an official e-Receipt?
questionMs: Adakah sumbangan saya layak mendapat pelepasan cukai di Malaysia, dan bagaimana saya menerima e-Resit rasmi?
answer: Yes! Hope For Strays (Persatuan Harapan Haiwan Terbiar) is a registered welfare society approved under Subsection 44(6) of the Income Tax Act 1967 (Approval Ref: LHDN.01/35/42/51/179-6.4912). When you make a donation or sponsorship pledge through our website with your Full Name and Malaysian IC / Passport / SSM Company Number, you receive a pledge reference to quote on your transfer, and an official computerized tax-exempt e-Receipt with full LHDN reference numbers is emailed to you once our coordinator has matched that transfer against the shelter's bank statement, usually within 2 working days.
answerMs: Ya! Pertubuhan Kebajikan Hope for Strays merupakan badan kebajikan yang diluluskan di bawah Seksyen 44(6) Akta Cukai Pendapatan 1967 (Ruj: LHDN.01/35/42/51/179-6.4912). Setiap sumbangan tunai yang disahkan layak menerima e-Resit pengecualian cukai rasmi untuk taksiran cukai individu atau korporat, dihantar melalui e-mel selepas penyelaras kami memadankan pemindahan anda dengan penyata bank.

question: How much does it cost to adopt a pet from Hope for Strays?
questionMs: Berapakah kos untuk mengadopsi haiwan dari Hope for Strays?
answer: All of our adoptions are free of charge. We do not sell animals. Every adoption already includes spay/neuter surgery, core vaccinations (6-in-1 for dogs, FVRCP for cats), microchip registration, deworming, and tick and flea treatment. We do welcome a voluntary donation to help us cover the next rescue's medical bill, but it is never a condition of adoption and no adopter is ever turned away for declining.
answerMs: Semua adopsi kami adalah percuma. Kami tidak menjual haiwan. Setiap adopsi sudah merangkumi pembedahan pemandulan, vaksinasi teras (6-dalam-1 untuk anjing, FVRCP untuk kucing), pendaftaran mikrocip, nyahcacing, serta rawatan kutu dan pinjal. Kami mengalu-alukan sumbangan sukarela untuk menampung kos perubatan haiwan seterusnya, tetapi ia bukan syarat adopsi dan tiada pengadopsi ditolak kerana tidak menyumbang.

question: What are the eligibility requirements to adopt?
questionMs: Apakah syarat kelayakan untuk mengadopsi?
answer: Adopters must be at least 21 years old and able to show proof of identity and address. If you rent, or live in a condominium, apartment or flat, we require written consent from your landlord or the building management, because many high-rise developments in Selangor restrict pet ownership. We also ask that you agree to post-adoption check-ins at one, three and six months, and that you commit to returning the animal to us rather than rehoming it independently if your circumstances ever change.
answerMs: Pengadopsi mestilah berumur sekurang-kurangnya 21 tahun dan boleh menunjukkan bukti pengenalan dan alamat. Jika anda menyewa, atau tinggal di kondominium, apartmen atau rumah pangsa, kami memerlukan kebenaran bertulis daripada tuan rumah atau pihak pengurusan bangunan, kerana banyak pembangunan bertingkat tinggi di Selangor mengehadkan pemilikan haiwan. Kami juga meminta anda bersetuju dengan susulan pada bulan pertama, ketiga dan keenam, serta berjanji memulangkan haiwan kepada kami dan bukan memindahkan miliknya sendiri sekiranya keadaan anda berubah.

question: Do you carry out a home visit before approving an adoption?
questionMs: Adakah anda menjalankan lawatan rumah sebelum meluluskan adopsi?
answer: Yes. After your application passes the initial review we arrange a home visit, either in person for homes within the Klang Valley or over a video call for applicants further afield. The visit is not an inspection of how tidy your home is. We are checking that balconies and windows are gridded or netted, that gates and fencing are secure, that the animal will live indoors with the family rather than chained outside, and that everyone in the household agrees to the adoption. Most visits take under thirty minutes.
answerMs: Ya. Selepas permohonan anda melepasi semakan awal, kami akan mengatur lawatan rumah, sama ada secara bersemuka bagi kediaman di Lembah Klang atau melalui panggilan video bagi pemohon yang jauh. Lawatan ini bukan pemeriksaan kekemasan rumah anda. Kami memastikan balkoni dan tingkap bergrill atau berjaring, pagar selamat, haiwan akan tinggal di dalam rumah bersama keluarga dan bukan dirantai di luar, serta semua ahli isi rumah bersetuju dengan adopsi ini. Kebanyakan lawatan mengambil masa kurang tiga puluh minit.

question: How long does the adoption process take from application to homecoming?
questionMs: Berapa lamakah proses adopsi dari permohonan sehingga pulang ke rumah?
answer: Most applications are reviewed within one to two working days. Allowing for the home visit and a meet-and-greet at the sanctuary, the full process usually completes within one to two weeks. Applications for animals with ongoing medical treatment, or for puppies and kittens still completing their vaccination course, can take longer because we will not release an animal before its treatment is finished.
answerMs: Kebanyakan permohonan disemak dalam tempoh satu hingga dua hari bekerja. Dengan mengambil kira lawatan rumah dan sesi suai kenal di santuari, keseluruhan proses biasanya selesai dalam satu hingga dua minggu. Permohonan bagi haiwan yang masih menerima rawatan perubatan, atau anak anjing dan anak kucing yang belum melengkapkan jadual vaksinasi, mungkin mengambil masa lebih lama kerana kami tidak melepaskan haiwan sebelum rawatannya selesai.

question: Can I bring my current dog to meet an adoptable dog first?
questionMs: Bolehkah saya membawa anjing saya untuk bertemu anjing yang hendak diadopsi?
answer: Please do, and we strongly encourage it for dog-to-dog placements. We run structured, supervised introductions in the outdoor compound at our Petaling Jaya sanctuary so both animals meet on neutral ground. Bring your dog's vaccination card, keep it on a non-retractable leash, and set aside about an hour. If the first meeting does not go well, that is useful information rather than a rejection, and our coordinators will help you consider a different match.
answerMs: Silakan, malah kami amat menggalakkannya bagi penempatan anjing dengan anjing. Kami menjalankan sesi perkenalan berstruktur dan diselia di kawasan lapang santuari kami di Petaling Jaya supaya kedua-dua haiwan bertemu di tempat neutral. Bawa kad vaksinasi anjing anda, gunakan tali leher yang tidak boleh ditarik panjang, dan peruntukkan lebih kurang sejam. Jika pertemuan pertama kurang lancar, itu adalah maklumat berguna dan bukan penolakan, dan penyelaras kami akan membantu anda mempertimbangkan padanan lain.

question: Can I adopt an animal that is currently listed as 'In Rehabilitation'?
questionMs: Bolehkah saya mengangkat anak haiwan yang berstatus 'In Rehabilitation' (Dalam Pemulihan)?
answer: Yes, through our 'Foster-to-Adopt' pre-adoption matching track! If you feel a deep connection with an animal undergoing recovery, you can submit an application. Our veterinary and behavioral team will review your household setup. If approved, you can visit the animal during their recovery phase, bond with them, and transition them into your home once their veterinarian grants final discharge clearance.
answerMs: Ya, melalui program 'Asuh-ke-Adopsi' (Foster-to-Adopt)! Anda boleh menghantar permohonan awal. Sekiranya diluluskan, anda boleh melawat haiwan tersebut sepanjang tempoh pemulihan dan membawanya pulang sebaik sahaja doktor veterinar mengesahkan pelepasan kesihatan penuh.

question: Where is the shelter and when can I visit?
questionMs: Di manakah lokasi santuari dan bilakah saya boleh melawat?
answer: Our sanctuary is at No. 18, Jalan SS 2/72, 47300 Petaling Jaya, Selangor. We are open to visitors Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed every Monday for deep cleaning and veterinary rounds. No appointment is needed to browse, but if you have a particular animal in mind, message us ahead so we can make sure it is not already out on a meet-and-greet.
answerMs: Santuari kami terletak di No. 18, Jalan SS 2/72, 47300 Petaling Jaya, Selangor. Kami dibuka kepada pelawat pada hari Selasa hingga Ahad, 10:00 pagi hingga 5:00 petang, dan ditutup setiap hari Isnin untuk pembersihan menyeluruh dan pemeriksaan veterinar. Tiada temu janji diperlukan untuk melihat-lihat, tetapi jika anda berminat dengan haiwan tertentu, hubungi kami lebih awal supaya kami dapat memastikan ia tidak sedang keluar untuk sesi suai kenal.

question: How do I get to the sanctuary by public transport or car?
questionMs: Bagaimanakah cara ke santuari menggunakan pengangkutan awam atau kereta?
answer: The sanctuary is a ten-minute walk from Taman Bahagia LRT station on the Kelana Jaya line, and several RapidKL bus routes stop along Jalan SS 2/24. If you are driving, free street parking is available along the service road, and there is a covered visitor bay beside the main gate reserved for adopters collecting an animal. E-hailing drop-offs should use the gate on Jalan SS 2/72 rather than the rear service lane, which is used by our transport van.
answerMs: Santuari ini sepuluh minit berjalan kaki dari stesen LRT Taman Bahagia di laluan Kelana Jaya, dan beberapa laluan bas RapidKL berhenti di sepanjang Jalan SS 2/24. Jika anda memandu, tempat letak kereta percuma tersedia di sepanjang jalan susur, dan terdapat petak pelawat berbumbung di sebelah pintu utama yang dikhaskan untuk pengadopsi yang datang mengambil haiwan. Pemandu e-hailing hendaklah menurunkan penumpang di pintu Jalan SS 2/72 dan bukan di lorong servis belakang, yang digunakan oleh van pengangkutan kami.

question: Can I bring my children to visit the shelter?
questionMs: Bolehkah saya membawa anak-anak melawat santuari?
answer: Children are very welcome and we think meeting the animals teaches them a great deal, but they must stay with an adult at all times inside the kennel areas. Some of our residents are recent rescues that are still nervous around fast movement and loud noise, so our staff will point out which enclosures are suitable for young visitors on the day. We ask that children do not put fingers through the fencing.
answerMs: Kanak-kanak amat dialu-alukan dan kami percaya pertemuan dengan haiwan mengajar mereka banyak perkara, tetapi mereka mesti sentiasa bersama orang dewasa di dalam kawasan kandang. Sebahagian penghuni kami ialah haiwan yang baru diselamatkan dan masih gementar dengan pergerakan pantas serta bunyi kuat, jadi kakitangan kami akan menunjukkan kandang yang sesuai untuk pelawat muda pada hari tersebut. Kami memohon agar kanak-kanak tidak memasukkan jari melalui pagar.

question: Can the public or university students visit the Rehabilitation House to meet the animals?
questionMs: Bolehkah orang awam atau pelajar universiti melawat Rumah Pemulihan untuk bertemu haiwan?
answer: Yes! Our sanctuary and rehabilitation house in Petaling Jaya is open to the public Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Closed on Mondays for deep sanitization and veterinary rounds). Walk-in visitors can meet our adoptable and recovering animals in our outdoor yard. For sponsored animal bonding sessions or group student visits, we recommend booking a slot 48 hours in advance via WhatsApp so our volunteer coordinators can dedicate time for you.
answerMs: Ya! Santuari dan rumah pemulihan kami di Petaling Jaya dibuka dari Selasa hingga Ahad, 10:00 pagi – 5:00 petang (Tutup pada hari Isnin untuk sanitasi menyeluruh). Pengunjung boleh melawat haiwan di laman santuari. Bagi sesi khas penaja atau rombongan pelajar, kami mengesyorkan tempahan 48 jam awal melalui WhatsApp.

question: How do I sign up to volunteer, and what is the minimum commitment?
questionMs: Bagaimanakah cara mendaftar sebagai sukarelawan, dan apakah komitmen minimum?
answer: Register your interest through the Volunteer & Foster section of this site and our coordinator will invite you to the next orientation, which we run on the first Saturday of each month at the sanctuary. Volunteers must be 18 or older to handle animals unsupervised; those aged 13 to 17 are welcome when accompanied by a parent or guardian. We ask for one four-hour shift a month so that the animals see familiar faces, but many of our volunteers come weekly.
answerMs: Daftarkan minat anda melalui bahagian Sukarelawan & Jagaan Sementara di laman ini dan penyelaras kami akan menjemput anda ke orientasi seterusnya, yang diadakan pada Sabtu pertama setiap bulan di santuari. Sukarelawan mestilah berumur 18 tahun ke atas untuk mengendalikan haiwan tanpa penyeliaan; mereka yang berumur 13 hingga 17 tahun dialu-alukan jika ditemani ibu bapa atau penjaga. Kami memohon satu syif empat jam sebulan supaya haiwan mengenali wajah yang biasa, namun ramai sukarelawan kami hadir setiap minggu.

question: What does fostering involve, and who pays for the costs?
questionMs: Apakah yang terlibat dalam jagaan sementara, dan siapa menanggung kosnya?
answer: Fosterers take an animal into their home temporarily, most often a nursing mother with her litter, an under-socialised rescue, or a dog recovering from surgery that cannot rest properly in a kennel. Hope for Strays supplies the food, litter, crate and all veterinary care, and covers every medical cost for the duration of the placement. You supply the space, the routine and the patience. Placements typically run from two weeks to three months, and we never ask a fosterer to keep an animal longer than they agreed to.
answerMs: Penjaga sementara membawa haiwan pulang ke rumah buat sementara waktu, selalunya ibu yang sedang menyusu bersama anaknya, haiwan yang kurang bersosial, atau anjing yang sedang pulih daripada pembedahan dan tidak dapat berehat dengan baik di kandang. Hope for Strays membekalkan makanan, pasir kucing, sangkar dan semua rawatan veterinar, serta menanggung setiap kos perubatan sepanjang tempoh penempatan. Anda menyediakan ruang, rutin dan kesabaran. Penempatan biasanya berlangsung dua minggu hingga tiga bulan, dan kami tidak sekali-kali meminta penjaga menyimpan haiwan lebih lama daripada yang dipersetujui.

question: How can corporate organizations or university clubs collaborate with Hope For Strays UM for CSR?
questionMs: Bagaimanakah organisasi korporat atau kelab universiti boleh bekerjasama dengan Hope For Strays UM untuk program CSR?
answer: We actively host structured Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and University Club volunteering days! Programs include: (1) Hands-on shelter workdays (dog walking, kennel sanitization, fence painting), (2) TNRM awareness and education campus booth collaborations, (3) Corporate donation matching drives, and (4) In-kind sponsorship of Rehabilitation House equipment. Contact our Partnership Coordinator via WhatsApp or email info@hopeforstrays.org to receive our CSR collaboration dossier.
answerMs: Kami sering menganjurkan hari sukarelawan Tanggungjawab Sosial Korporat (CSR) dan Kelab Pelajar Universiti! Antara aktiviti termasuk: sesi memandikan & membawa anjing berjalan, pembersihan fasiliti, pameran kesedaran TNRM kampus, dan tajaan peralatan pemulihan. Hubungi penyelaras rakan kongsi kami melalui emel info@hopeforstrays.org.

question: Can I surrender my pet to the shelter?
questionMs: Bolehkah saya menyerahkan haiwan peliharaan saya kepada santuari?
answer: We accept owner surrenders only when we genuinely have space, and our kennels are usually full, so please contact us before bringing an animal to the sanctuary. Speak to a coordinator first: many surrenders are driven by a landlord dispute, a new baby, a behavioural problem or a vet bill, and we can often help you resolve the underlying issue and keep your pet at home. If surrender really is the only option, we will ask for the animal's vaccination and medical records and an honest account of its temperament, because accurate information is what lets us find the right next home rather than a failed placement.
answerMs: Kami menerima penyerahan daripada pemilik hanya apabila kami benar-benar mempunyai ruang, dan kandang kami selalunya penuh, jadi sila hubungi kami sebelum membawa haiwan ke santuari. Berbincang dengan penyelaras terlebih dahulu: banyak penyerahan berpunca daripada pertikaian dengan tuan rumah, kelahiran anak, masalah tingkah laku atau bil veterinar, dan selalunya kami dapat membantu anda menyelesaikan punca sebenar serta mengekalkan haiwan itu di rumah. Sekiranya penyerahan benar-benar satu-satunya pilihan, kami akan meminta rekod vaksinasi dan perubatan haiwan serta gambaran jujur tentang perangainya, kerana maklumat yang tepat membolehkan kami mencari rumah seterusnya yang sesuai dan mengelakkan penempatan yang gagal.

question: Are your animals vaccinated and sterilised before they go home?
questionMs: Adakah haiwan anda divaksin dan dimandulkan sebelum dibawa pulang?
answer: Every animal leaves us sterilised, microchipped, vaccinated with the core course for its species, dewormed and treated for ticks and fleas. The only exception is a puppy or kitten too young for surgery: in that case we place it on a sterilisation undertaking, hold a refundable deposit, and book the procedure with our panel clinic once it reaches the right age and weight. You will receive the full medical record and microchip number at handover.
answerMs: Setiap haiwan meninggalkan kami dalam keadaan telah dimandulkan, bermikrocip, divaksin dengan jadual teras bagi spesiesnya, dinyahcacing serta dirawat kutu dan pinjal. Satu-satunya pengecualian ialah anak anjing atau anak kucing yang terlalu muda untuk pembedahan: dalam kes itu kami mengikatnya dengan akujanji pemandulan, menyimpan deposit yang boleh dikembalikan, dan menempah prosedur dengan klinik panel kami sebaik ia mencapai umur dan berat yang sesuai. Anda akan menerima rekod perubatan penuh dan nombor mikrocip semasa penyerahan.
